definitions.full: H6750. tsalal I. [ צָלַל ] verb tingle, quiver (Late Hebrew צִלְצֵל whirr (rare); Arabic , ; צְלַל ᵑ7 ; Syriac ); — Perfect 3plural צָֽלְלוּ Hab 3:16 ; Imperfect 3feminine plural תְּצִלֶּינָה 1Sam 3:11 , תִּצַּלְנָה (Ges § 67g ) 2Kin 21:12 ; Jer 19:3 ; — tingle , of ears, at horrid sound 1Sam 3:11 ; 2Kin 21:12 ; Jer 19:3 (all of dreadful news); of lips, quiver in terror Hab 3:16 .
